purpose: Test the timed visual argument, reading load and attention flow before final treatment.
hard_gates: Timing must preserve meaning, proof readability, caption clearance and exact approved assets.
soft_gates: The sequence should feel intentional, premium and easy to follow without visual overload.

failure.fallback: Return to styleframes or visual planning with the exact beat that lost clarity.

regression_cases: A proof beat remains on screen long enough to read.
An experimental device cannot bypass animatic approval.
